what: Masco makes home improvement products: Behr paint sold through Home Depot, Delta and Hansgrohe taps and showers, and related plumbing and decorative products.
customers: Home improvement retailers, plumbing wholesalers, builders and professional contractors.
money: Delta and Hansgrohe taps, showers and plumbing fittings
Behr and Kilz paint and related products
moat: Behr's exclusive position in Home Depot, the largest paint retail channel in the United States, and Delta's position with plumbers and builders.
risks: Repair and remodelling activity has been weak with high mortgage rates
Revenue has fallen about 4% a year over three years
Tariffs raise the cost of imported plumbing products
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Return on invested capital of 31%, very high for a building products company
Operating margin of 16% maintained through a weak demand period
A recovery in house moves would lift paint and fixture demand quickly
watch: Volume trends in paint and plumbing, and gross margin after tariffs.
